content.summary: The baseline and adjacent-budget numerical results reproduce exactly. Manuscript and canonical snapshot hashes match. The manuscript correctly limits the failed stronger bound to this numerical relaxation.

checks.method: Read the approved script, then executed independently written nested integer loops in memory over positive ordered degrees through nineteen, retaining all three sum constraints. Frozen evidence was not modified.
checks.observation: Both budgets admit exactly 6,031 tuples. Budget 58 gives maximum 4,475 with unique maximizer (19,14,13,13), L=31, U=875; budget 59 gives 4,553 at the same tuple with U=888. Counts, maxima, and maximizers match F26. The first lies thirteen below the required 4,488; the second exceeds it by sixty-five. These are exact relaxation calculations, not constructions of families, evidence that support 53 is optimal, or an additional universal Lean theorem. Reproduction occurred within the shared environment.
